changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 1 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6237-wizard-step-config-split.md`

- names `WizardForm.tsx` → `packages/plugin-form/src/WizardForm.tsx` — edited by this change

  > `WizardStepConfig` is now declared independently in `WizardForm.tsx`, which is simply what `SplitFormSectionConfig`, `ModalFormSectionConfig` and `DrawerFormSectionConfig` already do: each layout owns its group shape, documents `className` / `gridClassName` in its own terms, and declares `visibleWhen` only where its renderer honours it. The derivation flips from subtractive to additive — a key is authorable on a wizard step only if someone writes it there.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `c3a26ccda` (merge-base with origin/main): 2 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1562 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2149 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36289431349)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `6d66f607b9126fb999977a0864a11abe018e1c13`

### ① Derived judgments

Read: card objectui#10726 (body + 3 comments), triage `5851651489`, claim `5851765092`, the PR body and file list, the diff `c3a26ccda..6d66f607b` (merge-base = `main` tip), the head files via `git show refs/review/pr-10737:…`, the four siblings at the head, `loadFailure.ts`, `AGENTS.md` 版本号策略, `.changeset/config.json`. The `os-dev-report` comment was not used as evidence. The diff consumes no `@objectstack/spec` symbol.

**Behaviour changes (all in `packages/plugin-form/src/WizardForm.tsx`, +15 −0):**

1. `WizardForm.tsx:506` — new `loadedRecordIdRef = React.useRef(undefined)`. RIGHT. It is the same ref, same type, same comment text as `TabbedForm.tsx:328` and `SplitForm.tsx:218` (also `DrawerForm.tsx:312`, `ModalForm.tsx:390`).
2. `WizardForm.tsx:577` — `if (loadedRecordIdRef.current !== schema.recordId) setLoading(true);`, placed after the create / no-`recordId` / no-`dataSource` return (`:555-569`) and before `findOne` (`:580`). RIGHT. Verbatim the line at `TabbedForm.tsx:367` and `SplitForm.tsx:266`, in the same position. `DrawerForm.tsx:363-366` and `ModalForm.tsx:443-446` are the same guard plus `setIsDirty(false)`; the wizard has zero hits for `isDirty`, `onDirtyChange` or `beforeunload`, so the loading half is the whole of what applies. The triage's binding text 「Give the wizard's record read the swap-loading shape its siblings have」 is met: the shape IS a sibling's shape (TabbedForm / SplitForm, named above), not a new mechanism.
3. `WizardForm.tsx:582` — `loadedRecordIdRef.current = schema.recordId;` after the `if (cancelled) return;` at `:581`. RIGHT. Same as `TabbedForm.tsx:372`, `SplitForm.tsx:271`, `DrawerForm.tsx:371`, `ModalForm.tsx:451`. A superseded run never advances the key.
4. Claim limits, each checked: the other five layouts are untouched (file list is three files); PR objectui#10723's `cancelled` guard (`:550`, `:581`, `:591`, `:594`, `:601`) and PR objectui#10704's `beginLoadRun` slots (`:553`, `:566`, `:589`, `:592`) are byte-identical to base, and the new lines sit beside them only; the dependency list at `:602` is unchanged; no prop, export or schema key is added (`WizardFormSchema` at `:212` and `WizardStepConfig` at `:115` unchanged). The body's first line is `Fixes #10726`.

**Swap-key walks (head), each compared with TabbedForm / SplitForm, whose code is identical line for line:**

- `r1` lands ⇒ swap to `r2` ⇒ back to `r1` while `r2` is in flight. Swap: ref `r1` ≠ `r2` ⇒ `setLoading(true)` ⇒ spinner (`:1017-1024`). Back to `r1`: the `r2` run's cleanup sets `cancelled`; the new run finds ref `r1` = `r1`, so no new `setLoading(true)`, but `loading` is already true ⇒ spinner stays; `findOne(r1)` re-issued; on landing `:582-594` sets `formData` to fresh `r1` and `finally` ends loading. `r2`'s late answer hits `:581` and commits nothing. `loading` ends. Identical on all four siblings.
- `r2`'s read FAILS (ref stays `r1`), later re-run for `r2`. Fail: `:590-592` `run.fail(err)` ⇒ `loadFailures.record` set ⇒ the error screen at `:1008-1015` replaces the whole form (no `r1` value drawn or editable); `finally` ends loading. Re-run for `r2`: ref `r1` ≠ `r2` ⇒ `setLoading(true)`; the error screen stays until that run's `run.commit()` at `:589` clears the record failure; then the form draws `r2`. On success or a second throw `loading` ends via `finally`. Same as siblings (`loadFailure.ts:26-30`).
- Same-record re-run (`initialValues` rebuilt, or `objectSchema` change): ref = `recordId` ⇒ no `setLoading(true)` ⇒ step form stays mounted with the current `formData` while the re-read is in flight; on landing `setFormData(data)` replaces it. Pinned by the new test (`recordSwapLoading.test.tsx:282-296`). Same as siblings. (Pre-existing and untouched: the re-read landing replaces `formData` wholesale, including values merged from earlier steps by `handleStepSubmit` at `:749-751`; the deps and `:584` are base lines.)
- edit ⇒ create ⇒ edit on the same id: edit lands (ref `r1`); create branch (`:555-569`) seeds once (`seededRef`) and ends loading, ref is NOT cleared (no sibling clears it either, `TabbedForm.tsx:353-364`); back to edit `r1`: ref `r1` = `r1` ⇒ no loading; the create seed is drawn and editable until `findOne(r1)` lands. `loading` never re-enters and stays ended. Parity with siblings; the PR discloses this in its Acceptance notes.
- `objectName` or `dataSource` change with the same `recordId`: the schema effect (`:513-540`) never sets loading true; the record effect re-runs with ref = `recordId` ⇒ no loading; the previous object's values stay drawn and editable until the new read lands (then again when `objectSchema` lands and the effect re-runs). `dataSource` to undefined takes the `:555` branch and ends loading. Parity with `TabbedForm.tsx:338-391`; disclosed by the PR.

**`loading` always ends on the current run:** success ⇒ `:594`; throw ⇒ `:594`; a superseded run skips its own `finally` (`!cancelled`), and the run that superseded it either sets loading true and ends it on its own landing/throw, ends it at `:567`, or leaves it untouched for a same-record re-run and ends it at `:594` when it lands. No path leaves the wizard on its spinner that the siblings do not share (the `objectSchema`-null gate at `:598` is a base line common to all five). Create mode: the new line sits after the `:568` return, so a create wizard never re-enters loading; the initial `useState(true)` at `:435` is base and unchanged.

**Existing pin edits in `recordSwapLoading.test.tsx` (+65 −7):** the seven removed lines are the four comment lines that said "four" (`:91`, `:93`, `:96`, `:108-110` reworded to "different"/"every other one") and the `SectionedFormType` union at `:118`, which gains `'wizard'`. No assertion, timing or fixture of the modal, drawer, tabbed or split rows changed; `CONTAINERS` (`:120-127`) appends the wizard so the four sibling rows run as before; `OVERLAY_CONTAINERS` (`:130`) still filters to modal + drawer. Harness refactor, no guard weakened.

**New pins — can they fail?**
- Wizard swap row (`:149-167`): lit control is the drawer row (same assertion at `:163`). Negative leg: on base `WizardForm.tsx` (blob `7ec1efefa`) nothing sets loading true, `titleInput()` still reads `Record One`, so `.not.toBe('Record One')` fails; at head the synchronous `setLoading(true)` before the first `await` unmounts the step form within `rerender`'s act, so `null` is read. Fails on base, passes at head. The stale-response row (`:169-188`) passes on base too (the objectui#10723 guard), so it is a control, not a new pin.
- Same-record re-run (`:282-296`): negative leg is an unconditional `setLoading(true)`, under which `titleInput()` is `null` and `toBe(drawn)` fails. Can fail.
- Create-wizard re-run control (`:249-273`): fails under an unconditional `setLoading(true)` placed before the create return. Observation, not a defect: because a create wizard has no `recordId`, the guarded comparison `undefined !== undefined` is false, so this control would still pass if the guarded line were moved above the create return; it pins "a create wizard never re-enters loading", not the line's placement as the PR's H3 sentence reads.

**Missing / unasked:** nothing asked is missing. The two extra wizard controls are in the file the claim names and about the wizard only; not a scope breach.

**Open question and observation:** (1) Recommendation A (keep `currentStep` / `completedSteps` / `invalidSteps`) is sound and its premise is true at the head: the spinner unmounts the `SchemaRenderer` (`:1017` returns before `:1059`), and on landing it remounts with `defaultValues: formData` (`:1191`) and `previousValues: persistedRecord` (`:1195`), both replaced at `:584-585`, so no step draws an `r1` value once `r2` lands. While the new read is in flight on a step other than step 1 the wizard draws only the spinner, step indicator included, and resumes on the same `currentStep` with `r2`'s values. What does carry over is progress state: `completedSteps` ticks (which unlock click-jumps at `:1003`) and `invalidSteps` marks from `r1`'s last submit; base behaviour, not values, and not asked by the card. (2) The `recordId`-only swap key is true of all five layouts (lines cited above); it is a parity fact of the shape the triage binds to, correctly left out of this card.

**Pending changeset `6237-wizard-step-config-split.md`:** still true. `WizardStepConfig` is declared in `WizardForm.tsx:115`, the diff does not touch it, and the `*When` type-level assertion it cites lives at `packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/tabbedFormSectionPredicate-6237.test.tsx:365`.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/10726-wizard-swap-loading.md`: `'@object-ui/plugin-form': patch`. Correct: two source files of one released package change, no API moves, no `major` (AGENTS.md 版本号策略 forbids `major`; the fixed group bumps together at patch). Not a `content/docs/**`-only change, so a real changeset is owed and present.

Changeset prose, sentence by sentence: (1) mounted edit wizard kept drawing the previous record while the new one was read — TRUE (base has no `setLoading(true)` in the record effect). (2) values stayed on the current step and editable — TRUE. (3) now does what Drawer/Modal/Split/Tabbed already do, back to loading until the answer lands — TRUE (`:577`, `:594`). (4) only a change of record does this — TRUE (`:577` guard). (5) same-record re-run stays on screen — TRUE (pinned `:282-296`). (6) a create wizard never goes back to loading — TRUE (`:568` return precedes `:577`). (7) step / completed / error marks carry over as before — TRUE (no reset added; component state survives the early return). (8) no step draws a previous-record value once the new record lands — TRUE (`:1191`, `:584`). (9) no prop, export or schema key changes — TRUE.

Added test/code prose: the test header addition (`:29-32`) — TRUE. The `CONTAINERS` comment "A wizard step is a section, so `SECTIONS` is its one step" — TRUE. The `WizardForm.tsx:501-505` and `:571-576` comments — TRUE. Pre-existing header line `:12` still says "these four containers"; not a diff line, style only.

### ③ Boundary flags

- PR body flags answered above: H1/H2/H3 hold at the head; the open question's recommendation A is accepted with its premise verified; the out-of-scope observation is accurate for all five layouts.
- CI at `6d66f607b`, 42 check-runs. First read: 27 success, 3 skipped, 1 failure, 11 in progress. Re-poll 1 (02:54Z): 30 / 3 / 1 / 8. Re-poll 2 (02:56Z): 36 success, 3 skipped, 1 failure, 2 in progress (`Spec Main Shape Gate`, `Test (shard 4/8)`). The failure is `Inert vi.mock Specifier Check`. It is inherited: the same check fails on `main`'s own head `c3a26ccda` in two runs; the diff contains zero `vi.mock` call sites; and the gate's scripts run locally on scratch exports of head and of main both name the one same site, `apps/console/src/__tests__/filterContextTokensSweep-10666.test.tsx:51` (a specifier under `packages/plugin-map/node_modules/…` a bare checkout lacks).
